work.author: PIVS EPISCOPVS SERVUS SERVORUM DEI
work.description: The act erects the diocese of Pasto from Popayán. Issuer evidence: PIVS EPISCOPVS SERVUS SERVORUM DEI at LF2115-2118. Dating LF2532-2535 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctum Petrum Anno In- carnationis Dominicae Millesimo Octingentesimo Quin- quagesimo Nono, Quarto Idus Aprilis, Pontificatus No- stri Anno Tertiodecimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
